basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a civil engineer based in Hamilton, Ontario, working on infrastructure projects during the day and moonlighting as a gamer by night. I've been a Redditor for a year and a half, diving into niche subreddits like CK3 and CosplayHelp in my free time. While my work involves precise calculations and planning, I enjoy the chaos and creativity of strategy games and cosplay. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings unwinding on Reddit or diving into a new game. My typical online hours range from 7 PM to midnight on weekdays, with more sporadic activity during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in civil engineering from McMaster University, which has provided me with strong analytical skills and a detail-oriented mindset. My expertise in engineering often crosses over into my gaming, where I apply strategic thinking to conquer virtual challenges. I am mostly self-taught in gaming strategies, picking up tips from fellow gamers and online communities.
